lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਜਲੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar khetee taravar ka(n)the baagaa pahirahi kajal jharai ||
lines.translation: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ehu sa(n)saar tisai kee kothee jo paisai so garab jarai ||6||
lines.translation: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਯਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rayat raaje kahaa sabaae duhu a(n)tar so jaasee ||
lines.translation: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਰਹਸੀ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak gur sache kee pauRee rahasee alakh nivaasee ||7||3||11||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; only the Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11||
Maaroo, Third Mehl, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,
is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ehaa vedan soee jaanai avar k jaanai kaaree jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure? ||1||
He Himself unites in His Union.
He Himself inspires us with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem kee saar soee jaanai jis no nadar tumaaree jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.
By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so jogee ih jugat pachhaanai gur kai sabad beechaaree jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.
Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g siu nit raleeaa maanai apane ka(n)t piaaree jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||3||
Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.
He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai marai ma(n)daa hovai giaan beechaaree jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu sabad saar jis no laae ||
lines.translation: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad
becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aapan leeaa kichhoo na paaeeai kar kirapaa kal dhaaree jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestows power. ||5||
The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.
In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan jaataa jin kau nadar tumaaree jeeu ||6||
lines.translation: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom You bestow Your Grace. ||6||
One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;
he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baajhahu sabh dha(n)dh kamaavai vekhahu man veechaaree jeeu ||7||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||
Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.
Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad rate bairaagee hor bharam bhule gaavaaree jeeu ||8||
lines.translation: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. The other ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||
Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Name of the Lord
those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: agai vin naavai ko belee naahee boojhai gur beechaaree jeeu ||9||
lines.translation: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||
The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.
Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis too devahi soee paae naanak tat beechaaree jeeu ||10||1||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1||
